content: Neural machine translation (NMT) BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 , BIBREF4 has achieved remarkable performance on many bilingual translation tasks. It is an end-to-end learning approach for machine translation, with the potential to show great advantages over the statistic machine translation (SMT) systems. However, NMT approach has not been widely applied to the ancient-modern Chinese translation task. One of the main reasons is the limited high-quality parallel data resource.
